execution: 63 original QA-SRL predicates; 126 span prompts per model evaluation, 19 evaluations.
result: Removing A/B options did not produce a reliable natural-language repair.
lesson: Candidate order was one problem; free span extraction introduced additional failures.
limit: Same exposed source panel; exact span/format errors are not pure semantic errors.

execution: 63 QA-SRL source items, 504 prompts per evaluation; 19 evaluations.
result: Untouched actor 168/252, patient 104/252; complete eight-question items zero in every arm.
lesson: The synthetic adapter improvement did not establish natural sentence repair.
limit: Strong option-order biases; source selection and annotation uncertainties.

execution: Frozen DistilBERT; active-only versus balanced active/passive probes; UD evaluation.
result: Actor-second improved to 42–44/44 from 29–37; actor-first losses prevented an overall gain.
lesson: Balanced exposure can alter a syntactic probe's invariance tradeoff.
limit: UD subject/object proxies are not independently adjudicated semantic roles; not generative repair.

execution: 120 fresh events, 480 prompts per Qwen checkpoint.
result: Qwen1.5B active generic 10/120 versus performed 91/120; passive 120 versus 119. Qwen0.5B differed.
lesson: Measured role accuracy depends strongly on question formulation and checkpoint.
limit: Behavioral sensitivity does not identify a missing binding mechanism or monotonic size effect.

execution: Dense ordinary-training checkpoints 25/30/35 plus earlier trajectory.
result: Exact checkpoint-40 replay; development-selected ordinary checkpoints failed reserved-wording matching.
lesson: The tested finite early-stopping grid did not reproduce the auxiliary tradeoff.
limit: Does not exclude arbitrary regularization, schedules, or adaptive selection bias.

execution: 75 independent UD-EWT source items; frozen adapter comparisons.
result: Untouched primary contrast 57/75, sentence omitted 48/75, paraphrase 72/75; direct actor 16/75, object 2/75, joint zero.
lesson: Independent-source evaluation exposed scoring and copying alternatives.
limit: Syntactic proxy labels and direct-answer format confounds; not semantic gold.

execution: Qwen1.5B 64 events, 256 prompts, logit lens and whole-state patches.
result: Generic active 3/64 versus passive 64/64; performed active 38/64. Block20 true actor preferred in 23/35 selected errors.
lesson: Wrong outputs can coexist with some correct-name preference under an intermediate readout; state patches steer answers.
limit: Selected errors, uncalibrated logit lens, sentence/name position, and whole-state copying confounds.

execution: Fresh 64-event internal follow-up; 48 eligible active cases.
result: Generic active 0/64, passive 64/64; performed active 48/64. Same-sentence performed donor corrected 41/48 at block20; patient donor zero.
lesson: Question-conditioned state differences can causally change answer preference.
limit: Role versus first/last mention remained confounded; no unique role selector identified.

execution: 51 previously exposed QA-SRL Gold predicates; span-likelihood contrast analysis.
result: Sentence-conditioned role contrasts showed signal beyond some candidate-only comparisons.
lesson: Graded contrast can expose context dependence missed by direct generation.
limit: Not fresh corpus-blind confirmation, nor evidence of reliable native answering.

execution: 256 natural QA-SRLBank examples, 256 updates, two starts, natural-only and replay arms.
result: Held Bank role contrast 97→121 and 93→121; replay could harm clefts.
lesson: Natural exposure can improve this contrast metric; synthetic replay is not automatically beneficial.
limit: Adaptive recipe and inherited adapters; actor-first skew 244/256 training, 126/130 test.

execution: Qwen0.5B/1.5B; 24 semantic events and 192 prompts per initial model panel.
result: Large wording and format sensitivity motivated larger confirmations.
lesson: The original task was strongly affected by the interface.
limit: Small adaptive pilot; no claim about unseen pretraining relations or mechanisms.

execution: Fresh Qwen1.5B 64 events, 384 responses.
result: Generic actor active 13/64, passive 60/64; performed active 41/63. Joint-format role scores differed.
lesson: Paraphrasing the demand changes measured competence substantially.
limit: Different prompts can change retrieval and output preparation simultaneously.

execution: Three new lexical graphs × two starts; matched ordinary versus ordered-role auxiliary training.
result: Patient-cleft accuracy 51.51% ordinary versus 75.53% ordered auxiliary.
lesson: A bounded adapter recipe altered held-out synthetic construction performance across six units.
limit: Later unordered-participant control outperformed it; ordered roles were not shown necessary.

execution: Qwen0.5B, one graph, four matched arms; 240 examples, 120 updates, 5,400 tests.
result: Ordered-role auxiliaries protected cleft performance relative to ordinary training.
lesson: Useful feasibility for a training intervention, followed by fresh confirmation.
limit: One graph; auxiliary heads not at ceiling; superseded v2 trained-arm results invalidated.

execution: Qwen1.5B 64 events, 512 prompts, four sentence constructions.
result: Active generic 4/64 versus performed 63/64; passive 64/64; object cleft generic 56/64 versus performed 41/64.
lesson: A wording repair can reverse direction across syntax; simple last-name prediction is insufficient globally.
limit: Does not distinguish syntactic parsing, attention, or output policies.

execution: Qwen0.5B, one graph, one start, 480 updates.
result: Controlled role auxiliary training did not convincingly transfer to the LLM task.
lesson: The scratch-model result did not automatically bridge to a pretrained model.
limit: Single development run; not a definitive null on auxiliary methods.

execution: Ordinary checkpoints 20–120; exact final-adapter replay.
result: Sampled earlier ordinary checkpoints failed to reproduce the auxiliary performance tradeoff.
lesson: The observed benefit was not explained by the tested global stopping points.
limit: Finite sampled schedule and reused evaluation data; not a universal exclusion of regularization.

execution: Same six graph/start units, unordered participant auxiliary control.
result: Unordered patient-cleft 83.82%, above ordered-role training.
lesson: The LLM auxiliary benefit did not require an ordered role target.
limit: Does not identify which identity, gradient-budget, or regularization feature caused the benefit.

execution: Fresh 64 events, 512 prompts per Qwen0.5B/1.5B.
result: Qwen1.5B active generic 8, performed 51, carried-out 40, actor 5 out of 64; passive near ceiling.
lesson: Explicit technical role words were not a general fix.
limit: Checkpoint-specific behavior; no internal causal conclusion.

execution: Candidate-free typed-versus-neutral training; 160 updates, 4,238 target tokens, two starts.
result: The two-start candidate-free success criterion failed.
lesson: Earlier candidate-supported routing gains did not establish free entity binding.
limit: Actor-first data skew and broad later semantic remapping; no post hoc rescue counts as confirmation.

execution: Two starts; slot SFT versus voice/swap coupling; 48 updates, 1,152 rows, 36 fresh events.
result: Joint object-cleft performance remained 1–2/36; extra coupling loss could regress.
lesson: Explicit equivariance constraints did not repair the tested generalization gap.
limit: Specific loss, budget and small model only.

execution: Same exposed 40 QA-SRLBank items; fixed fields, tags and swapped fields.
result: Cue changes helped select fields; wrong supplied fields could also be followed.
lesson: Externally printed structure can control answer selection.
limit: Does not show native relational computation or a general natural-language repair.

execution: Scratch goal-first versus answer-first engineered two-hop task.
result: Training used padding-mask id0 instead of the actual pad token.
lesson: The apparent decomposition comparison is scientifically invalid.
limit: Do not reinterpret the recorded outcomes as a negative learning result.

execution: Clause auxiliary direction task, successor to goal-first v1.
result: Inherited padding defect; nominal success screen did not pass.
lesson: No licensed comparison of decomposition methods.
limit: Raw failures cannot isolate the linguistic hypothesis.

execution: Corrected pad id2; fresh grammar bank and five paired starts.
result: Oracle normalized clause views helped direction operations; intact mixed questions still failed.
lesson: External decomposition can make this grammar easier.
limit: No demonstrated entity binding, native parser, or general procedure learning.

execution: Learned keep/drop selector trained on 6,000 examples; frozen v4 operator; 400 seen and 400 mixed-new tests.
result: Selector-plus-operator transferred under the fixed engineered grammar.
lesson: Explicit intermediate supervision can support a bounded pipeline.
limit: Extra model, token selection labels, deterministic preprocessing; no spontaneous algorithm discovery.

execution: Need-first versus roles-first natural QA-SRL training, 160 train and 40 fresh items, 11,676 targets.
result: Changing output order did not produce reliable goal-first repair; adaptive classifier/router helped.
lesson: Printed planning order alone was insufficient; external routing adds capabilities.
limit: Adaptive extra-model comparison is not matched end-to-end evidence.

execution: Five arms, two starts; 160 train, 40 development plus 51 exposed Gold predicates.
result: Role fields became more consistent, but native final answers were only 75/160 and 76/160 in highlighted arms.
lesson: Producing better-looking fields does not ensure their correct use.
limit: Noisy labels and visible fields; mediation not established.

execution: 40 new Bank items, two starts; tags, candidates and answer order varied.
result: Explicit role tags did not reliably repair free generation and could change extracted fields.
lesson: Question classification was not the only bottleneck.
limit: Candidate-supported versus free extraction remain different tasks.

execution: Natural-role fine-tuned Qwen checkpoints tested on controlled syntax.
result: Performance shifted toward subject/construction dependence; small checkpoints differed.
lesson: Natural fine-tuning did not establish robust semantic-role equivariance.
limit: Exploratory checkpoint comparison; syntax and answer policy competitors remain.

execution: One seed; Stage-C ordinary and consolidation schedule arms.
result: All tested alternatives reached the relevant ceiling.
lesson: There was no headroom to identify a consolidation-specific improvement.
limit: No artificial-sleep or schedule mechanism conclusion.

execution: One seed; 30 transformed-verb held-out events.
result: Ordinary augmentation and both consistency schedules all scored 30/30.
lesson: Lexical transfer existed here but did not distinguish the schedules.
limit: Not independent multi-seed evidence or a consolidation mechanism.

execution: Extra object-cleft exposure under matched training budget; 36 fresh lexical events.
result: Additional construction exposure did not reliably repair object-cleft answering.
lesson: The simplest missing-construction-exposure account was insufficient in this setup.
limit: Does not rule out larger data budgets or other training recipes.

execution: Two starts; balanced QA versus role-coupled distributions, 864 matched targets.
result: Consistency improved but the predeclared repair threshold failed.
lesson: Consistency and accurate answers need separate evaluation.
limit: Generic regularization remains a competitor.

execution: 36 fresh events × four forms × five questions; eight checkpoints, 5,760 responses.
result: Benefits on trained wording could coexist with harm on unseen actor demands.
lesson: A repair must generalize over questions, not just constructions.
limit: No claim that all paraphrases or model families behave alike.

execution: 960 prompts, four checkpoints, output-format crossover without retraining.
result: Answer-before-fields removed the slot-first advantage; format violations were frequent.
lesson: The claimed benefit depended on the output contract.
limit: Malformed-output confounding prevents a pure estimate of semantic computation order.

execution: Six unused name pairs, four new verbs, 48 events, 960 prompts per checkpoint; six checkpoints.
result: Slot-first benefit persisted versus answer-first and candidate-list controls on the synthetic panel.
lesson: This bounded output-order effect survived a fresh lexical check.
limit: Does not establish transfer to natural prose or an internal role-selection mechanism.

execution: Two starts; matched answer-first versus actor/patient-first training; 8,640 targets, 96 updates.
result: Slot-first improved controlled behavior; deterministic routing strengthened apparent gains.
lesson: Output decomposition can help within this synthetic task.
limit: External router and later adaptive candidate-list placebo are not native mechanism evidence.

execution: 51 predicates, 49 QA-SRL Gold sentences; 204 prompts per checkpoint, six evaluations.
result: Direct synthetic repair did not transfer; printed oracle fields routed only 109–112/204.
lesson: Natural source and output selection remained bottlenecks.
limit: Candidate-two bias, exposed source selection, incomplete annotation adjudication.

execution: Mixed active/passive and both clefts; matched 96 updates and 576 targets.
result: Construction tradeoffs persisted after broader training coverage.
lesson: A single missing construction did not explain the failure.
limit: Some bank choices were adaptive; not a general impossibility claim.

execution: Replace active-cleft training with passive examples.
result: Passive improvements came with active/cleft losses.
lesson: The model could learn a construction-specific policy rather than stable roles.
limit: Limited training recipe and checkpoint scope.

execution: Typed NeedACTOR/PATIENT versus neutral cue; 160 train and 40 fresh Bank items.
result: Train-only question classification plus typed cues helped candidate-supported answering.
lesson: Explicit demand information can improve a constrained interface.
limit: Not independently adjudicated semantic gold; classifier and candidates supply extra structure.

execution: 20 new Bank items; two-token typed tags matched to neutral tags.
result: Candidate-supported effect persisted; removing candidates hurt extraction; oracle fields reached 38/40.
lesson: Routing competence can coexist with poor participant extraction.
limit: No demonstrated candidate-free training repair at this stage.

execution: 32 calibration plus 24 new scratch models; selected auxiliary weight .001.
result: Nonfocal ability gap +.68pp passed matching; focal attenuation −6.10pp, p=.140625, failed.
lesson: The earlier high-weight benefit was not confirmed under the tested ability-matched setting.
limit: Finite weight choice; null does not prove every role auxiliary ineffective.

execution: Six scratch models, original versus dedicated padding/balanced distractors; 12 checkpoints.
result: Familiar performance ≥99%; held-out gap changed inconsistently across worlds.
lesson: Generator artifacts did not yield a single sufficient explanation.
limit: Small selected development set.

execution: Reused 96 rewire/repair models; 9D probe and equal-norm random intervention controls.
result: Ordered-trained decisions depended more on the tested role directions.
lesson: A causal role-related subspace existed in this small synthetic system.
limit: Reused cohort; probe-defined directions do not establish a unique circuit or pretrained-LLM mechanism.

execution: 160 scratch models, five arms, old graph families.
result: High-weight ordered attenuation +22.57pp with ability mismatch; role-swap loss only +.33pp over compute-only.
lesson: General capacity/optimization and auxiliary weighting matter.
limit: Not fresh graph confirmation; specific role-swap objective had no convincing benefit.

execution: One old graph and a fresh initialization.
result: Held role accuracy baseline 93.52%, unordered 86.08%, ordered 98.00%.
lesson: Ordered supervision could help this graph/seed.
limit: Not a fresh graph-level confirmation.

execution: 72 scratch models: eight fresh nonisomorphic graphs × three starts × three arms.
result: Frozen rule supported ordered role supervision beyond unordered participant identity.
lesson: There is a replicated causal training effect in the controlled graph world.
limit: Not evidence of language understanding, a unique circuit, or transfer to LLMs.

execution: Three old graphs × two starts; baseline, unordered and ordered auxiliary arms.
result: Ordered roughly 98–99% versus baseline 80–93% and unordered 81–94%.
lesson: Motivated the later fresh-graph confirmation.
limit: Previously used graphs; exploratory training comparison.

execution: Adaptive v1–v4 probes on the same frozen confirmation cohort; selected 16-model analysis.
result: Both-role probe accuracy about 64.47% unordered versus about 76% ordered; targeted interventions exceeded random controls.
lesson: Ordered training changed causally relevant role-related geometry.
limit: Adaptive analyses and reused models do not add independent replications or identify a unique mechanism.

execution: 72 scratch models; eight new graphs × three starts × three arms.
result: Unordered high-minus-low overlap −22.82pp; ordered attenuation +19.95pp.
lesson: A graph-associated transfer penalty and training interaction replicated.
limit: Common neighbors, path structure and other graph properties were not independently isolated.

execution: 72 models; eight families × three starts × original/sham/high-overlap rewires.
result: High versus sham −26.33pp, p=.0078125.
lesson: Changing the matched rewire package causally altered transfer.
limit: The package changed both common-neighbor and path structure; no unique graph statistic established.

execution: 48 models; eight fresh graph pairs × three starts, low/high triangles matched degree.
result: High-minus-low mean −1.82pp, interval [−6.91,+3.27], p=.4375; frozen rule failed.
lesson: The proposed triangle-based prediction did not replicate.
limit: Does not establish either sign as a law.

execution: 96 new models; eight new graph families × three starts × two rewires × two auxiliary arms.
result: Unordered rewire penalty −24.45pp; ordered attenuation +22.59pp; frozen rule passed.
lesson: Role supervision causally reduced a transfer penalty under these graph manipulations.
limit: The graph feature responsible remained unidentified.

execution: 96 new models; 12-node factorial with four-edge paths additionally matched.
result: Common-neighbor contrast −9.94pp, interval [−20.46,+.58], p=.0781; Holm .1563; strict gate failed.
lesson: The isolated feature claim did not meet its confirmation rule.
limit: No promotion of the earlier bundled rewire effect to a common-neighbor law.

execution: 96 models; initial 12-node common-neighbor × three-edge-path factorial.
result: Common-neighbor estimate −9.94pp but frozen criterion failed; four-edge paths remained unmatched.
lesson: The apparently simple graph explanation required stronger controls.
limit: Superseded by the stricter experiment; not a confirmed feature-specific causal result.

execution: 576 original outputs exactly replayed; 288 sentences across six model units, AP versus PA output order.
result: Field labels disappeared under reversal while name-order behavior persisted.
lesson: Observed adapter development was compatible with output/mention order policies.
limit: Reused outputs and constrained templates; no semantic circuit claim.

execution: 21 model units, 8,064 prompts, 2,016 sentence/model comparisons.
result: Extraction and direct-QA rankings differed; apparent joint-cleft recovery could follow the last name.
lesson: Evaluation interface can reverse model comparisons.
limit: Not direct evidence that an internal role representation improved.

execution: Saved adapter evaluations re-scored under mention-order and semantic patterns.
result: Highlighted untouched cases: LLL 42/96 versus semantic FLL 21/96.
lesson: A simple output-position explanation reproduced part of the apparent role pattern.
limit: Does not fully model all items or all checkpoints.

execution: Independent parser/scorer audit of 21 units and 2,016 comparisons; four checks.
result: Saved comparison counts reproduced.
lesson: The arithmetic was independently checked.
limit: No independent generation or scientific replication.

execution: Frontier/history notes and research positioning.
result: Summarized exposure, confounds and possible next questions.
lesson: Planning helped define what would count as progress.
limit: Not an experimental finding.

execution: Research reboot and source-exposure audit.
result: Official QA-SRL test material was already exposed in earlier work.
lesson: Those items cannot be retrospectively treated as pristine held-out confirmation.
limit: Documentary provenance, not a new model result.

execution: Saved three-role score matrices; assignment-constrained decoder, both models.
result: External one-to-one assignment recovered 36/36 cases in each model; native Qwen had 15/36, Llama 29/36 complete.
lesson: Native decisions and externally recoverable task structure differ.
limit: Post hoc; deleting Qwen's sender row still gave 36/36, exposing an elimination shortcut.

execution: Qwen/Llama carrier-candidate acquisition and baseline screening.
result: Native competence screens failed; substantive causal routes were untested.
lesson: A plausible-looking carrier cannot be interpreted without validated task behavior.
limit: Saved descriptive arrays and post hoc bias diagnostics are not causal findings.

execution: Initial role-path patches, full paths, path-schedule controls, factorial gate and syntax transport.
result: Some answer steering; generic path similarity and failed competence/transport gates.
lesson: Whole trajectories and full-vector patches did not establish shared linguistic computation.
limit: See separate children; several reports reuse the same eight prompts and vectors.

execution: 24 fresh lexical families × eight prompts × two models; 1,562 forwards.
result: Qwen active 55→89/96 but passive 95→87; Llama active 69→91 and passive 78→86 after fixed calibration. Qwen family test 19 positive, zero negative, five ties, p=1.907e−6.
lesson: A fixed output correction changes both accuracy and which cases pass competence selection; filtered cross-model depth comparisons can shift substantially.
limit: Shared templates limit exchangeability/generalization; calibration is not a novel linguistic mechanism.

execution: 192 baseline answers; component capture available.
result: 161/192 correct; zero causal component patches.
lesson: The proposed causal comparison was not reached.
limit: A failed prerequisite is not evidence that component reuse is absent.

execution: Known-program correspondence benchmarks, including a 64-score DSA exercise.
result: Restricted affine cases worked; nonlinear/global invariance counterexamples survived.
lesson: Similarity methods require explicit transformation assumptions.
limit: Synthetic method diagnostics, not LLM linguistic discoveries.

execution: Competing event-selector and syntax-aware/compound-key copier predictions audited before inference.
result: No valid distinction could be constructed under the proposed full-state intervention; zero new inference.
lesson: Stopping was scientifically correct: the experiment could not identify the desired mechanism.
limit: Does not erase earlier answer-source steering; does not refute every possible event-selection test.

execution: Six pinned public repositories plus official supplements inspected.
result: No admissible paired artifact replication found; a static Dai notebook baseline-correspondence issue recorded.
lesson: External comparisons need verifiable matching artifacts.
limit: Static notebook issue does not overturn the paper; no independent empirical replication ran.

execution: Qwen1.5B/7B and Llama3B, eight fresh lexical families.
result: Only one family jointly met relevant competence requirements.
lesson: Observed distance curves were insufficient for a family-dependent computation claim.
limit: No clean causal comparison or general family law.

execution: 24 exposed natural items; 2×2 span instruction/Answer-prefix manipulation, 192 new outputs and 48 scored candidate pairs.
result: A stronger direct answer contract explained much of the apparent pipeline advantage.
lesson: Prompt/output specification was a serious alternative to deficient relation processing.
limit: Old items and selected formats; no general repair or new mechanism.

execution: Standard-library replay of 1,562 saved prospective records.
result: Saved counts and model comparison arithmetic checked.
lesson: Improved evidence traceability.
limit: No new model inference or independent sample.

execution: 540 generations on 12 exposed items; direct, span, self-review and field interventions.
result: Highlighted direct 11/24, span 14/24, self-review 6/24; correct fields did not guarantee correct answers.
lesson: Answer packaging and field selection matter separately from field production.
limit: Small reused development panel; printed-field reliance is not native causal role binding.

execution: Saved contrasts and exact score algebra; no new model calls.
result: Output-based alternatives remained sufficient for important apparent effects.
lesson: Simpler predictors should precede more expensive mechanistic claims.
limit: Hypothesis generation on exposed data, not confirmation.

execution: 24 exposed active natural items; frozen query variants and deterministic routing.
result: Qwen0.5B direct 17/48, query-visible 1, blind+routed 8; Qwen1.5B 19, 2, 31 respectively.
lesson: External routing can help one checkpoint and harm another.
limit: Grammar metadata and router are supplied externally; no native procedure discovery.

execution: Gallistel reading, existing-trace assessment and proposed measurements.
result: Separated information availability, evidence, causal use and output; no automatic stage correspondence licensed.
lesson: Functional distinctions can sharpen experiments.
limit: No new inference or evidence that temporal-learning equations are computed by an LLM.

execution: One joint-replay seed completed; paired clause run interrupted during epoch2 after padding bug discovery.
result: Partial outputs retained; inherited mask defect invalidates the scientific comparison.
lesson: Implementation validation was necessary before another decomposition claim.
limit: Not an unrun study and not a valid negative result.

execution: 1,758 forwards; six families/model, two development and four evaluation families.
result: Qwen cut14→21 source-release signature passed 5/8 evaluation cells and 2/4 families, below rule; Llama had no development candidate.
lesson: Some graded routing effects existed without a stable generalizing signature.
limit: No clean stage transition or shared Qwen/Llama mechanism.

execution: Saved blockwise residual writes.
result: No early invariant process established; attention/MLP tensors were unavailable for the intended decomposition.
lesson: Block deltas alone did not identify internal operations.
limit: Magnitude and downstream output preparation remain confounded.

execution: Three small grammar-feature MLPs; nonlinear coordinate changes and learned transport.
result: Known exact transport corrected false blind disagreement; held cross-seed predictor passed only 1/2.
lesson: Coordinate-invariant comparison is possible with additional assumptions/data, but learned correspondence was not robust.
limit: Methods pilot on artificial networks, not a linguistic LLM mechanism.

execution: 32 fresh code-legend cases; eight full units.
result: 16/32 correct, zero complete units; last-option predictor also 16/32.
lesson: A sole last-option rule was insufficient; compound category/key lookup still fit.
limit: No interpretable semantic code mechanism or behavioral repair.

execution: Atlas continuation after serialization repair; 69/132 cumulative planned calls.
result: Technical tests passed, both development competence screens failed; zero held-out calls.
lesson: The implementation repair did not validate the scientific prerequisite.
limit: No causal atlas or held-out linguistic result.

execution: Controlled argument-boundary proposal and role×voice algebra.
result: Binary role×voice design had an exact alias; no new forwards.
lesson: Surface and relational factors need separable predictions before collection.
limit: Design work is not evidence of a developmental law.

execution: Two Qwen forwards and one offline answer before failure.
result: Answer serialization bug stopped the pilot; no held-out or Llama run.
lesson: The first attempt produced no interpretable scientific comparison.
limit: Do not count technical interruption as a failed linguistic hypothesis.

execution: Integrated saved observatory results.
result: No demonstrated shared linguistic mechanism; retained distinct behavior, readout and causal evidence tiers.
lesson: A single attractive trajectory summary hid different failure modes.
limit: No new independent data.

execution: Local Llama3B panel and hosted Gemma panel on the controlled sentence set.
result: Llama object-cleft joint cases weak; hosted Gemma solved the highlighted 12/12 construction cells under both tested wordings.
lesson: Some apparent binding failures were model/interface dependent and avoidable.
limit: Different families, scales and backends are confounded; historical hosted use only, none in this audit.

execution: 90 planned native cases; 89 journaled plus one recovered, 189 raw forwards; zero causal patches.
result: 75/90 native answers correct, only 2/15 source families complete and 2/15 recipient families complete; ordinal 44/45.
lesson: Matched demand did not produce a valid broad causal panel.
limit: Early-stop deviation and recovered record are explicit; no causal conclusion. Same-folder post hoc surface correction 86→103/108 was exploratory.

execution: Natural source feasibility, small-model panels, stronger-model panels, stress and event-label patches.
result: Natural data were available; Qwen7B label-state transfer steered 9/10 answers in five fresh documents, 4/5 complete.
lesson: Answer-source redirection is real within the bounded panel.
limit: Event identity versus order/key retrieval remained unresolved; see child records and person/team prompt failure.

execution: 55 reports indexed at the time; this audit adds two archived factorial reports.
result: Historical hashes and report provenance retained.
lesson: Old experiments are recoverable, but the old index was not exhaustive.
limit: Report counts are not experiment or independent replication counts.

execution: Discourse-load, factuality, source-feasibility and replication studies.
result: A fresh named-bystander panel produced seven wrong-event answers/64; later effects were smaller and model dependent.
lesson: Behavioral competition exists in some setups; no general law yet.
limit: Confounded first experiment, sentence-order rival, source uncertainty and strong clean-task baselines; see children.

execution: Course/paper research planning.
result: Organized possible claims and evidence gaps.
lesson: Planning is useful only when tied to discriminating tests.
limit: Not a result and not evidence of paper readiness.

execution: 323 forwards, 806 production and 1,136 independent audit checks; period-message K/V interventions.
result: No development-generalizing signature; all 16 calibrated recipient→donor transfers failed despite open-route effects.
lesson: The tested local content-port account did not explain steering.
limit: Only selected sites, cuts and interventions; distributed routes remain possible.

execution: Phi3 construction/question panel matched to the earlier stronger-model setup.
result: Question changes that helped Qwen7B could hurt Phi3.
lesson: No universal wording-induced role failure law emerged.
limit: Model family, training and size differ jointly; not a clean causal family comparison.

execution: Post-training novelty and claim review.
result: Located possible project framing and known alternatives.
lesson: A method's usefulness and its scientific novelty require separate evidence.
limit: No new experiment or verified priority claim.

execution: Exact-repeat, same-length suffix, variable-length and padded numerical controls.
result: Same-length suffix differences zero; length64/65 kernel route induced about .004–.005 prefix drift.
lesson: A numerical shape artifact explained the observed apparent prefix dependence.
limit: Not evidence of future-token leakage; later tests found no large angular or primary sign changes.

execution: One exposed reference; layer-streamed Qwen and batching equivalence checks.
result: Streaming was bit-exact with peak MLX about331MiB; batch4 max drift .1035 despite matching argmax, rejected.
lesson: Safe instrumentation allowed lower-memory experiments; argmax alone was insufficient validation.
limit: Engineering validation, not a mechanistic discovery; rejected batching was not used.

execution: 2,865 main forwards plus five technical stop trials; 360 native cases, 1,296 hybrid next-token records, 432 cut14 full answers, 72 full shams.
result: Native 239/288 primary, 47/96 complete; role-held-out MSE .570698 versus generic .504571, position .582356, nuisance .719906; primary role account failed. Source-consistent changed role 117/144, complete hybrid 69/144; native-competent complete 59/64.
lesson: The fixed intervention can redirect answer sources while role-indexed access lacks predictive support over tested alternatives.
limit: One model/task/cut; all-result and native-competent analyses differ. 71/72 R/direct-positive pairs, one excluded by frozen gate; no shared or novel linguistic mechanism.

execution: 48 unique saved Qwen evaluation prompts, reused for selection/readout analysis.
result: Active 14/24→24/24 and complete 0/6→6/6 after correction; passive stayed24/24.
lesson: A global output bias could account for selected competence failures.
limit: Post hoc, not independent confirmation; successor prospective study is the evidence test.

execution: Compiled reference Transformer routing programs and controls.
result: Restricted route predictions passed; architecture/depth/width metadata alone separated programs.
lesson: A benchmark can look mechanistic while exploiting implementation metadata.
limit: Published trained benchmark not run; not an LLM linguistic finding.

execution: Relational-access direction and source-access proposals; no result file in this directory.
result: Specified direction/causal mediation ideas and required controls.
lesson: These ideas informed later source-access experiments, whose outcomes are separate.
limit: No fitted direction, forward pass or scientific outcome evidenced here.

execution: 3,708 probe fits, zero Transformer forwards; two families/four sentences.
result: No robust portable decoder; final answer log-score gains negative in all4 highlighted cells; Llama period asymmetry.
lesson: Saved information can be decodable in a setup without supporting the requested generalization.
limit: Tiny source diversity; cannot infer absence of relational information.

execution: Relational consolidation Stage-A design/literature work.
result: Specified hypotheses and prerequisites.
